steps.name: Jewelry Trading Brokerage (1)
steps.objective: After talking with [Parmilla] and [Jubil] at “Oscuras Mercenary Camp”, go to [Asma] in “Luman”.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I have a small favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I've been busy with various things these days, so I don't think I've been able to pay much attention to the members. There are some good parts, but... .

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Hahahahaha, Arcane body slam!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You'll need some food to find the cat.

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Ugh… .  (I'm hungry)

lines.speaker: 마리스
lines.text: What should I do to make money? eww… .

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Hehe, this time I will make the ultimate medicine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean it looks okay?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's because I look at it from such a prejudiced perspective. So, would you listen to Jubil's story instead of those members?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on with Jubil?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: After listening to the story, I realized it wasn't something I could solve.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'm glad you showed up in the meantime. He has more experience, is stronger, and knows more people than me, so I think he will be of help to Jubil... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's possible if you just listen to the story.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thank you. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think there's something to that smile... But I guess it's not a big deal...)

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I was too busy to even say thank you. Otherwise, we might have become undead together... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.  Don't worry about that.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: By the way, do you have any business for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla asked me to listen to Jubil's story.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Ah, that's the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't mind, could you please tell me?

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Then let me talk. I thought Adventurer could help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll listen and decide.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Hehe, okay. These days, there are people wearing unusual clothes walking around Mirgandia, so I asked around and found out that they have a job called 'Jewel Star'.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Attack the monster by putting magic into the jewel and smashing it... . It was a bit surprising.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: So! That sounds like money!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. You came from a merchant family.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: That's right. We come from a family of jewelry merchants. The problem is that it's completely ruined now.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I want to earn a lot and quickly get rid of my mercenary life. The money collected here is only pennies. I need something certain.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Then Jewel Star appeared in front of me. Just supplying a large amount of jewels to Lumen, which has many jewel stars, would be a huge success!

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I, Jubil, the daughter of a jeweler, do not want to miss this opportunity.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: There is a route I know so I can get the gems they need. So, I would like to ask you something clearly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, they want to sell it to Luman, but they don't know anyone, so they're asking me to build a bridge in the middle.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: As expected, if you pretend, it's good that the story is fast. I thought Adventurer might know someone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do know. Then, would you like me to go and talk to you? I guess I have to go to Luman anyway... . Don't expect too much.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: In the name of my father, Cilan, I think it will do really well this time. And I think I can do well too.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: If everything goes well, I'll give you something really good. Even if it’s a stake… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then share it later.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Yes, thank you. Then I'll ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm... then should we go to Asuma? I wonder if Asuma would listen to the story about the jewel...)

steps.name: Gem Trading Brokerage (2)
steps.objective: Defeat the [Devouring Fire Spirit] in “Canyon of Chaos” and obtain <Spirit Fragment>. Then report to [Pulse] in the “Underground City of Tartarus”.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer. Uh, I think you have something to say... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . I have a favor to ask you, so I will tell you first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He brings up the story of Jubil’s request to Asuma.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: (Asuma looks embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: What should I do? I don't think I can give you a definitive answer since it's not my responsibility.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Then there is nothing we can do.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Still, you need a lot of gems. There is also a demand for people like wizards or Jewel Stars who use jewels... .

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The scale of the barrier we must continue to set up is also getting bigger... . Ah, he might be able to give a more definitive answer than me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is that?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: He is a stubborn person who knows nothing but research.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: (For a moment, Asuma's face hardens. It's the first time I've seen this expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you mean the Pulse of Tartarus?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes. Since you are friends with the school executives, why not go and talk to them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll go there.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Before you go, there is something the school officials asked him to bring. Could you get it for him and bring it to him? ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, I feel like I'll be scolded a lot if I don't do it...)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Then I'll assume you'll do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew. all right. I'll take care of it on the way.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I think you can find an item called ‘Spirit Piece’ in the space where the spirits live and bring it to them.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Thank you. And I hope you get good results.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, I'm scared. Next time, I'll have to make sure there's no talk about Pulse.)

steps.name: Gem Trading Brokerage (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Evil Order] in the “Frozen World” and obtain the <Pearl Embracing Darkness>. Then report to [Pulse] in the “Underground City of Tartarus”.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A person came, but couldn’t it be that he didn’t even feel like he was popular?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Oh, are you here?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought the things I needed. And I have a story to tell.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Thank you for bringing the items. But other than that, I'm not interested in the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Asma told me to tell that story to Pulse.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I can't help it. If it's Miss Asuma's story, I have no choice but to listen to it first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It explains why the Oscuras mercenary temporary station came here.)

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I understood what it was about. However, I don't think I can give you an answer right away.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I have some backlogged research, and for those things, I have to contact my seniors separately... . Coincidentally, we are running out of ingredients.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's missing? Let me try to save it.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: <Pearl Embracing Darkness> is an item that cannot be easily obtained... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I need to help you somehow to get the job done. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Then, I will put the flue to the seniors.

steps.name: Gem Trading Brokerage (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Violette] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pulse, pulse! I got some stuff.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Oh, are you here? Thank you for your effort

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Regarding the request, my senior decided to send someone to inform me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, then let's wait.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Someone is coming just now.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: (A person wearing clothes similar to Pulse approaches and starts talking about various things. Pulse's expression seems to harden little by little as she listens to the story.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The story didn't go well...)

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I am sorry.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: It is said that a large amount of gems have recently arrived in our school. I don't know who they are dealing with, but the quality seems pretty good.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Moreover, it is said that they are not planning to do business with other companies right now because they are not in a hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I'm sorry. Well then... .

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Hello. Pulse? Uh, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: I came here because I had a favor to ask of Pulse, but the atmosphere was serious. Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's not a big deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain the current situation to Violette.)

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: If you don't mind, Adventurer, can you come over to me and we can talk again? Oh, I'll ask Pulse next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. By the way, Pulse, thank you. See you next time.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Well done. Violet might give you a good answer. this… .

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: You're already gone. I still had something left to say... .

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Hmm, hmm. I think I can help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don’t have to force yourself to make a decision… .

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: No. I think this will be helpful to our Kingdom of Jude.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Jude Kingdom needs a large amount of gems? It seems like there were a lot of them in the Palace of the Sun... .

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: As you know, our kingdom suffered great damage from the last raid.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: As the country that was believed to be strong for a long time became like that, the residents began to lose trust in the country and the royal family.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: After pondering this, His Majesty the King ordered to install barriers at major bases like Lu Man.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: So the wizards imbued the jewels with magic and prepared a barrier starting from the capital... . I didn't know there would be that many jewels in it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, something like that happened.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: So, I was looking into places where I could trade jewelry. I couldn't find a suitable place in Eastland, but I think Adventurer brought some good news.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: So, I would like you to tell him that you would like to do business in Jude Kingdom.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: From then on, I… . No, we will proceed on our side through your father.

lines.speaker: 비올렛
lines.text: Sorry for the inconvenience.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'm glad it helped. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Judging from your expression, I think you brought me good news.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. So what happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Jubil that Jud Kingdom is thinking positively.)

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Thank you. Actually, all I had to do was sell the jewelry. Me and Adventurer just collect the commission as soon as it is brokered.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Hehe, now we need to solidify our internal stability.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I hope everything goes well.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Thank you. I will let Adventurer know as soon as there is further progress.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where do you get it in large quantities, enough to trade with the kingdom? As I was going back and forth, that was what I was most curious about.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Hmm… . Actually, it's difficult to tell you, but since you helped me, I'll just tell you. Please don't tell me anywhere else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Well then, I will trust Adventurer and tell you. Do you know Magic Academy Zelenis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I've heard of it.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: At some point, the chairman of the board, Chloris, noticed that there were a lot of gems in the school, so she contacted me and asked me to take care of them.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I was curious as to how I had so many gems, but I didn't ask. Actually, it has nothing to do with me, I just have to deal with the gems.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: It's good for the Magic Academy because it has increased finances, Jude Kingdom is good because it takes gems, and Adventurer and I are good because we can collect fees in the middle.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Isn’t that a pretty good deal?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess so. Still, I want to go to the magic academy and listen to the story. Is that not possible?

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Unauthorized people are prohibited from visiting Magic Academy Zerenis, so even I, who have known Chloris for a long time, would find it impossible to do so.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Besides, the road leading there is blocked right now. Sometimes Chloris comes through the air, but I don't know when she will come, so I wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand the situation. Then there is nothing we can do.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Yes, I will tell Chloris that Adventurer did a great job. It is said that half-elves will repay you double if you receive help, so look forward to it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Half-elf….)

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: This is the end of the story about Chloris. Because I don't want to talk about other people for a long time.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. I'll ask again next time!
